about: Serving rules for Olemmy (docs/OLEMMY.md §10a), in srvcfg's format (srvcfg/docs/server.md). Olemmy 1.0 uses hash routes (#/c/name), so no SPA fallback is needed; 404.html is a copy of the app shell for hosts that send it anyway. This file stays outside the public web root.

patterns.paths: Paths are relative to the web root, with / between folders and no leading /.
patterns.noSlash: A pattern without / matches a file name in any folder.
patterns.withSlash: A pattern with / matches the whole path.

etag.note: Send ETags and answer If-None-Match with 304. Content hashes are preferred; mtime-size requires preserving build file times.

publish.note: Upload every other file first, including the new file list. Replace deployment.json atomically, then purge it from any CDN.

always.note: no-referrer: the app talks to Lemmy instances and loads remote images; none of them need to know which page you were on.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: http: data: blob:; media-src 'self' https: http: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; frame-src blob: https:; font-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

rules.note: The same policy as the <meta> in index.html, plus frame-ancestors, which works only as a header. connect-src allows any https: origin because users pick their own Lemmy instance; http://localhost is for testing against a local Lemmy.
